worker_notes: Only n_o was assigned. All other fields/sides are unassigned placeholders. Target identified from Study 2, heart-attack outcome, and the average-student comparison condition, independently of row order or numeric matching. Rendered printed pp. 506–507 (PDF pages 5–6); Table 2 Average student header carries superscript b, whose Group A count is 25. This is the within-condition self-other comparison, not the omnibus F across three comparison targets. Table 2 also gives Group A condition counts 27 (one of your friends) and 31 (closest friend); these are different comparison conditions and are not summed for this target. prior_adjudication.reason: The coded original test on PDF p. 5 (p. 506) is the three-condition heart-attack MANOVA (F(14, 146) = 2.09, p < .02), so the blind and prior-review value of 25 is a wrong-target count from the single-condition Average student cell in Table 2, whereas shipped 190 is the combined Study 2 recruitment across Group A (n = 83) and Group B (n = 107, who never rated heart attack). Although 83 subjects were recruited into Group A (with univariate ANOVA df = 2, 80), the heart-attack MANOVA error df (146) is smaller than Group A's drinking-problem MANOVA error df (148) and the exact post-exclusion analytic n for F(14, 146) = 2.09 is not reported.

parent_response: New separately authorised source-grouped completion. Fresh blind extraction and exact evidence now supplied.
